notes.title: Beta Coming May 6th and Private Beta Live Now!
notes.content:
We've finally updated the game! It's been completely overhauled from the previous version and is finally ready to be tested. As this is our first update in a while, we're starting with a private beta, which you can access by [url=https://discord.gg/Dy5bfkTmWB]joining our Discord server[/url].
 
On May 6th, we will release the first public beta. We can't wait to hear what you think about the game, and we're excited to show you what we have planned.

notes.title: Latest Version now in Steam Betas
notes.content:
Hey there! Many changes are in the works for the upcoming release of version 0.1. But I don't want to fully release that version of the game yet, because there are still a lot of kinks to work out. And I still want to get feedback on what I've added so far, so I've released an unstable testing version of the game through Steam Betas. 

Here's how to access Steam Betas:
[list]
[*] Right-click Red Sector in your Steam library
[*] Select "Properties"
[*] Select "Betas"
[*] The beta access code is "spacebreadyo"
[*] Make sure you select "testing" from the dropdown
[*] Go back to your library and you should have an update for Red Sector. After the update, you're good to go.
[/list]

Some things to keep in mind for the current unstable version (0.99a):
[list]
[*] Make sure to click the big yellow button at the main menu once before you play. You should also disable the tutorial in the settings menu.
[*] Enemy variety will be pretty scarce. (I've just changed the whole spawning system, so now I can focus on actually adding more enemies.)
[*] I've left the testing controls active. These should fix 90% of the issues you run into.
[*] I'd like to know how the pace of the combat feels overall. 
[*] If you get bored in one sector, Press P to open the portal and go to the next sector. Each sector will have different levels of combat and different visuals.
[*] The pink skulls on the map are for mini-bosses which aren't in the game yet.
[*] In-game music has been disabled for now, as I work on improvements. But enjoy the new space ambiance!
[*] Remember to submit feedback and bug reports through the in-game pause menu. 
[/list]

Thank you for playing! There is [b]much[/b] more to come.

notes.title: A Look at What's to Come in Beta
notes.content:
I’ve just released a dev log detailing the work that’s gone into Red Sector so far, the challenges along the way, and what’s to come in version 0.1 (beta).

The game has come a long way, and beta is going to be a huge step in making the game into the experience that I’ve always wanted. Find out more by reading [url=https://agigames.net/red-sector/dev-log/5-29-2021-betabeyondandstruggles]the full development log.[/url]

I'm working really hard on this game, and I can't wait to share more with you.

notes.title: What's to Come in Alpha 0.0.9
notes.content:
The next update is going to be bigger than the previous updates have been, so it won't be released for at least another week, possibly longer.

[url=https://twitter.com/AGI_Games/status/1329877132110127104]Here's a little preview if you're curious.[/url]

What I'm working on is something the game has desperately needed for a while. But it's going to take a lot of work to achieve. And as I want it to be as good as I can make it, I'm not going to rush it. So hang on to your helmets, and follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/AGI_Games]Twitter[/url] for all updates on Red Sector's progress.

Thanks for playing and motivating me to improve the game.
